title: Microcohort rollout checklist and comm playbook (Jul 2028) - sketch
content:
Purpose:
This is a working sketch for a small-cohort (microcohort) rollout of the 2028.07 runtime and routing change. Goal is to validate latency and quality impact for a constrained subset of customers before a wider ramp.

Quick summary:
- Target cohort: 5% of Hosted traffic (users with stable region=us-west1, non-SLA small accounts)
- Window: 2028-07-15 -> staged ramp over 72h 
- Primary risk: sudden latency spike on 1s-3s paths and KV cache warmup behavior
- Primary rollback signal: error rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m or p50 latency > baseline+120ms for 10m

Owners and contacts:
- Release lead: Jordan Kim (oncall: pager INF-ops)
- SRE runbook owner: Dmitri Ivanov
- Product QA: Aria Patel
- Client-facing comms: Samira Lopez
- Exec escalation: Priya Anand (backup: Marcus Hale)
- Slack channel during rollout: #release-ops (pin this doc and REL-1122)

Pre-flight checklist (to complete 48h before cut):
- [ ] Finalize feature flagging gates and cohort selector (REL-1122) -- owner: eng-platform (see PR #4536)
- [ ] CI smoke green for x86 and aarch64 builds (nightly/master run) -- owner: release-ci
- [ ] Canary model variants uploaded & verified in model-catalog (m:redwood/rtc-v2-small) -- owner: model-onboarding
- [ ] Telemetry dashboards created: latency-p50/p95, error-rate, kv-cache-hit, token-cost-per-request -- owner: observability
- [ ] Alert thresholds provisioned in PagerDuty (incident rule: latency-thresholds) -- owner: SRE
- [ ] Release notes draft reviewed by product and docs -- owner: product-hosted-api
- [ ] Customer comms draft for affected cohort prepared (email + in-console banner) -- owner: customer-success
- [ ] Runbook printed to PDF and attached to ticket REL-1122 -- owner: release-admin

Cutover timeline (hour-by-hour, day 0 = 2028-07-15):
- T-02:00 (prep) -- final roll-call, ensure oncall rotation and backups are required; confirm telemetry links
- T-01:00 -- gate check: CI, canary smoke, model availability, infra quotas
- T-00:00 -- flip feature flag for 0.5% cohort (stage A) 
- T+00:15 -- validate initial telemetry (errors, latencies). If green -> continue to T+02:00
- T+02:00 -- increase to 2% cohort (stage B) -> validate 30m
- T+06:00 -- increase to 5% cohort (stage C) -> validate 1h
- T+24:00 -- automated health-check and secondary verification by QA
- T+48:00 -- review metrics, decide to continue ramp to 25% or rollback

Gating signals (explicit):
- Roll forward permitted when: error-rate <= 0.2% and p50 latency <= baseline + 80ms AND kv-cache-hit >= 85% within 1h of ramp
- Automatic rollback triggers: error-rate > 0.5% for 15m OR p95 latency > baseline + 250ms for 10m OR any customer-facing internal outage (SLO breach)
- Manual rollback reasons: high variability in tail latencies, emergent incorrect outputs seen in sample prompts, or increased token cost > 15% for cohort

Smoke / validation checklist after each stage increase:
- [ ] Run 50 synthetic prompts spread across seq-lengths (16,128,512) and compare outputs against baseline hashes (tolerate minor sampling difference) -- QA
- [ ] Check streaming session stability for 10 long-running sessions (simulate tool-calls) -- QA
- [ ] Verify consumer-facing headers: X-Model-Variant and X-Cache-Warm (for telemetry) -- infra
- [ ] Confirm no unhandled exceptions in runtime logs (grep for panic / unhandled) -- SRE

Telemetry dashboards to watch (links to pinned dashboards in #release-ops):
- cohort/latency: p50/p95/p99 by region and model-variant
- cohort/errors: 500s, 429s, 4xx spikes by route
- kv-cache health: hit-rate, evictions/sec, warmed-keys
- cost-metrics: token-rate, avg-cost-per-token for cohort

Stakeholder comms cadence:
- Pre-cut (48h): blog-inline update to docs + notes to top 100 customers who might be affected (customer-success)
- Day-of: hourly standups in #release-ops for first 6h, then 3x daily until decision point
- Post-48h: summary email + short postmortem template started if any gating incident fired

Fallback & rollback steps (fast path):
1) Flip feature flag back to previous stable selector (release-lead)
2) Scale down any dedicated routing workers allocated for the variant (infra)
3) Notify customers in cohort with short apology and expected resolution window (CS)
4) Create a hotfix ticket if root cause obvious (e.g. kernel regression) and attach logs + debugger trace (REL-hotfix-XXXX)

Post-rollout tasks (if rollout succeeds):
- Draft a lightweight postmortem / findings doc (3 bullets: perf delta, cost delta, quality delta) -- due 72h after finish
- Update model-catalog with profiling notes and recommended quantization setting
- Bake the cohort selector into gradual rollout automation (rel-automation ticket)
- Schedule follow-up QA for 30 days to catch regressions in long-tail prompts

Release notes (DRAFT - to be cleaned for public):
- runtime: improved routing for small-batch workloads, reduces queuing for short requests (p50 latency improvement ~40ms on our internal tests)
- models: promoted redwood/rtc-v2-small as the default for low-latency paths (behaviorally equivalent to rtc-v1 with tighter kernel dispatch)
- ops: added X-Cache-Warm response header so integrators can detect cold-starts for KV caching

Open questions / things to confirm (TODOs):
- Do we have an approved customer-facing blurb for the in-console banner? (action: Samira)
- Is there a fallback play for dedicated customers on Dedicated clusters if routing rules conflict? (action: infra)
- Should we include a short A/B prompt set for quality checks (10 prompts) in Rel-QA? (action: product/qa)
- Validate PD escalation rules for the new latency thresholds (action: SRE)

Quick logs & artifacts to attach to REL-1122 during rollout:
- DAG of feature flag changes with timestamps
- Redacted sample traces for any 5xx or p95 outliers
- Cohort selector SQL snapshot that created the initial 0.5% set

Notes to self / informal: 
- Keep on-call rotations short (<4h blocks) while we watch early stages; avoid context switching for the first 6h
- If we see KV warmups taking >30m, consider warming strategy: proactive prefetch for top 100 keys by route
- Remember: don't conflate token-cost drift with model-quality issues (cost drift often from batch shaping)

If you are reading this and want to add a checklist item, tag me in #release-ops or drop a quick PR to REL-1122 with the change.

End of sketch.
